messages:
maya_pm: TL;DR proposing an 'auto-renew' for pinned models: TTL-triggered controlled canary + tenant preview and opt-in credits. Need to lock launch gates and safe defaults.

aj_dev: +1. Need API to store renewal config and tenant-level opt-out. Also: who owns bench runs (research infra vs product infra)?

sasha_research: we can offer a bench-lite runner (bench_id: bench-lite) that checks golden prompts, embed-cosine drift, and quick perf samples.

maya_pm: proposed minimum gates: bench-lite pass; p99 latency delta <= 2%; embed cosine drift <= 1%; per-token cost delta <= 10%. Exclude tenants with contractual pin clauses.

tina_engineering: infra note: KV-cache warming is critical for p99. Small canaries are noisy; recommend synthetic warmups + spread canary attempts over a 7d window. Also need phased rollout orchestration and mid-roll rollback hooks.

lucas_support: comms: notify tenants at 30d/14d/7d with console "preview canary" link and opt-in toggle. Offer credits for consenting to auto-renew. Provide clear rollback contact.

aj_dev: API sketch: add to GET/POST /pins/{tenant}/{model}: ttl_days, canary_pct, bench_id, warmup_strategy, rollback_triggers. Console: preview + "run canary now" for SEs.

maya_pm: launch checklist: bench spec merged, infra cache-warmup validated in staging, support comms + legal opt-out filter, API and console mocks reviewed. Actions: aj->epic/API by EOW, sasha->bench PR, tina->infra plan, lucas->comms draft.

opsbot: scheduled_canary tenant=tenant_910 start=3851234800 status=initiated.
